title.narrative: Enhancement of the institutional capacity of the Government of Oman for industrial development through improvement of the statistical infrastructure

description.narrative: The project was implemented almost to a completion, while the counterpart requested extension by increasing the budget and adding new output. Part of the requested new activities dropped from the initial project due to lack of funds at the time of start of the project (see Note 2 below), others were found to be very important during the project implementation. Oman is currently the only Gulf Country that is performing annual industrial census. A statistical system operated by the Directorate General of Industry, at the Ministry of Commerce and Industry (MC), exists in Oman since 1993. This system implements annual industrial surveys of the active industrial establishments in the Sultanate (since 2002 covering only those with more than 10 employees). The current system needs to be revised and brought to the level of best international practices.
